description: A real (non-dry-run) Critic dispatch with `--reviewing TASK --commits SHA` builds its '## What to review' brief section from exactly the named commit's own diff (`worktrees.commit_set_diff`, `dispatch.py:1001-1014`), not the lane's full cut-point diff — `RealDispatchStore::review_scope`'s own `explicit_commits` branch (task `20261106-fixer-fbf55c`). The reviewed lane is a fixture branch (`projects.sandbox.lanes`) with one commit touching `src/auth/login.rs`; `--commits` names that same commit by its branch ref. Like dispatch-real-builder/dispatch-real-wait, this Rust-only scenario seeds stateful fake-herdr and uses current role names directly.

files..multiverse/routing.log: 2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00	event=dispatch	task=20261101-fixer-abcdef	project=sandbox	role=builder	account=seat-a	pool=chatgpt:excluded	outcome=chain-primary	reason=	branch=main
